headline: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited announces Scheme of Arrangement to NSE
sum: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited filed a Scheme of Arrangement with the National Stock Exchange. Details of the arrangement structure, valuation, parties and conditions remain undisclosed in publicly available sources.

The NSE filing itself—located at nsearchives.nseindia.com—is the primary disclosure point.
